text: これは　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごとじゃー！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる
structure.en: that will remain in Pokémon history

structure.jp: いだいな　しごとじゃー！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごと
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that...' in English. れきしに のこる しごと = 'work that will remain in history'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'is'; Professor Oak talks like this, and the long ー shows him shouting it with excitement. しごとじゃー = 'it's an undertaking!'.

patterns.name: 〜な (na-adjective)
patterns.explanation: Describing words like いだい need な before the thing they describe. いだいな しごと = 'a great undertaking'.
